privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Sidera works out charts without keeping them, unless you ask it to. This page says what happens to the details you give, who handles them and how to delete them.

glance.title: Sign in only if you want
glance.text: The free tools need no account. Save makes a guest account with no email or password. Google sign in is never required: it lets you open your reports on another device.

glance.title: Nothing kept by default
glance.text: A chart or a match is worked out and shown to you. A copy is kept only if you press Save, unlock a full report or create a share link. Free saved reports are deleted after 7 days.

glance.title: Saving and sharing are your choice
glance.text: You can delete a saved report, a share link or your whole account at any time.

glance.title: No birth details in logs
glance.text: Logs hold only the page, the result code and the time taken. There are no adverts and no tracking.

sections.title: What you give
body: The date, time and place of birth (or a latitude, longitude and time zone), and a name if you want one. A name is never needed. For a match, the same for two people, or only their birth stars.
These are sent in the body of the request, never in the page address, and are used to work out the result you asked for. An ordinary calculation is not saved.
If you enter another adult's details, please have their permission and tell them about this page. Permission to work out a chart is not permission to save it, share it or ask the AI about it.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To give you the chart, match, PDF, saved report or AI explanation you ask for; to keep the site safe from misuse; and where the law requires it.
You can leave out the optional fields, such as names. Without the birth details a calculation needs, we cannot work it out.
We do not sell personal information, show adverts or use tracking or analytics.

sections.title: Saved reports and your account
body: When you first press Save, this browser signs in to Supabase as a guest. A guest account is an id with no email, name or password. Supabase keeps that sign in in this browser's storage, not in a cookie.
A saved report keeps the result in Sinhala and English, with the details it was made from (names, birth date, time and place), so you can open it, download it and share it again.

A report you save without the full report is a free report. It is kept for 7 days from when you saved it and then deleted automatically, within an hour after its 7 days. Saving it again does not restart the 7 days. You can keep up to 20 free reports at a time, and you can delete them sooner in My reports.
A full report is kept until you delete it or your account. If you get the full report for a free report you saved, it stops expiring and is kept the same way.

You can continue with Google to open your reports on another device, for example after getting a full report. Supabase then keeps what Google shares at sign in: your Google account id, email address, name and picture address, and when you signed in. The site shows your email in My reports. Our server reads only your account id and whether you are a guest. Free reports in a Google account are still deleted after 7 days.

If you continue with Google on a browser that has guest reports, they and the full reports unlocked there move to your Google account. If that Google account already has reports from another device, the guest's reports join them and the guest account is deleted.

A guest account with nothing saved, no order and no use for 7 days is deleted automatically, once a day. Clearing this browser's data signs a guest out for good: its reports can no longer be opened from this browser, so continue with Google first if you want to keep them.

sections.title: Full reports and coupons
body: A full report needs no sign in. It is kept in the guest account on this browser, or in your Google account if you continue with Google, until you delete it or the account. Real payment is not available yet: for now a full report can be unlocked only with a coupon code that makes it free, or with a test payment that takes no money where the site offers one.

When a coupon or a payment unlocks a report, we keep an order record: the kind of report, its price, the coupon, the amount paid and the time. A payment you start is noted the same way, and deleted with your account. Instead of the birth details it holds a one-way fingerprint of them, which cannot be turned back into the details. If you delete your account, the order record stays with no link to you.

We note the time of each wrong coupon code, to stop guessing. These notes are deleted with your account. Wrong codes are also counted for your network address, in the server's memory only, for an hour.

sections.title: Sharing
body: When you create a share link, a copy of that result is kept in Sinhala and English. Names and birth details (date, time, place, time zone and coordinates) are left out unless you switch them on, and what you leave out is removed before the copy is stored. A match link never includes birth details.

Before you create the link, the Share dialog shows every field the other person will see. Even with names and birth details hidden, the chart itself (planet positions, the lagna and the life period dates) can let someone who knows astrology work out roughly when and where a person was born.

Anyone who has the link can read and forward what it shows. The link's preview in messaging apps never shows names. Share pages ask search engines not to list them, and ask browsers not to store them or pass their address on. The link code and its delete code are kept only as hashes, a one-way scramble that cannot be turned back into the codes.
A share link closes after 30 days and is then deleted. The browser that made it keeps the delete code, so you can delete the link sooner with Delete this link, but only on that device.
Deleting a saved report does not delete its share links; delete each link too. Deleting a link cannot take back screenshots or downloads someone already made.

sections.title: On your device
body: Your last result is kept in this browser tab, so a reload does not lose it. It is cleared when the tab closes.
If you tick Remember my chart on this device, that chart is kept in this browser until you press Forget. It is never kept on our servers.
When you press I understand on the AI notice, this browser remembers it so the notice does not show again.

Cookies: sidera_saved, set when you save, only shows the My reports link and holds no id; it lasts up to a year. sidera_chat, set when you ask Astro a question, holds a random id that counts this browser's free questions; it lasts up to a year. sidera_chat_turn links the suggested follow-up questions to the question just asked; it lasts 30 minutes. All three are needed for the site to work, and there are no other cookies.
Other people who use this device may see what it keeps.

sections.title: The AI helper
body: Before anything goes to the AI, the site shows a short notice. Nothing is sent until you press I understand.
When you ask Astro a question or press an Explain button, our AI server sends the chart facts on the page and your message to OpenAI, which writes the answer. AI is switched off for child results.

Sidera does not add names, birth dates, birth times or places of birth to what it sends. Your own message can include them, and chart facts can point to a person in context. Please leave out names, children's details, contact details and sensitive information about yourself or anyone else.
We ask OpenAI not to store the answers. Under OpenAI's API terms, what we send is not used to train its models, but OpenAI may keep it in abuse-monitoring records for up to 30 days.

Our AI server keeps the conversation only in its memory, so it can follow up on your questions. It is never written to disk or to a database, and it is deleted after 30 minutes without a new message, or sooner if the server restarts. Our logs do not hold message text.

For each question you ask Astro, we keep when it was asked, how much text (tokens) the answer used and what it cost. We never keep your questions or Astro's answers. For free questions this record is linked to the random id in the sidera_chat cookie and to a scrambled form of your network address that cannot be turned back into the address, and it is deleted after 8 days. For questions that use the chat that came with a full report, it is linked to your account and deleted when you delete your account.
AI explanations can be wrong. Sidera never uses them to make a decision about you.

sections.title: Logs
body: The servers record each request's method, page path, result code and time taken. Share codes are hidden in the path. Logs never hold names, birth details, AI messages or anything you typed.

The companies that host the site see network details such as IP addresses. We use IP addresses in memory to limit misuse. To limit how many free Astro questions can be asked from one network, we keep only a scrambled form of the address, for 8 days.

sections.title: PDF reports
body: A PDF is made on the server when you ask for it and sent straight to you. It is not kept. Copies you download are yours to keep or delete.

sections.title: Who runs the site
body: Vercel serves the pages. Render runs the calculations and the AI server, in Singapore. Supabase runs the database (saved reports, share links, accounts, orders and chat usage) and sign in, also in Singapore. OpenAI writes the AI answers; its systems may run in the United States and other countries. Google handles Google sign in.
Fonts and pictures come from the site itself. Your browser talks to Supabase for sign in and saved reports, and to Google only when you continue with Google.
We share information with these services only to run the site, or where the law requires it.

sections.title: Children
body: Sidera is for adults aged 18 or over. A parent or legal guardian may use the child tools, such as first letters, for their own child. We ask for the guardian's consent first, and record only that it was given and when. A child's name is never needed. Child results are not saved, are never sent to the AI and have no share link. A guardian can withdraw consent by leaving the box unticked, or later by contacting us.

sections.title: Your choices and deletion
body: To delete a share link, open it on the device that made it and press Delete this link.
In My reports you can delete one report or all of them, sign out of this phone, sign out everywhere, or delete your account. Deleting your account deletes every saved report and then your sign in.
To remove a remembered chart, press Forget.

You can also ask us to show, correct or delete information about you, or to stop using it, at the contact address that will be added below. We date every change at the top of this page and tell you about big changes before a new use begins.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: These terms cover Sidera's free features and reports unlocked with a coupon. The privacy page explains how your information is handled.

sections.title: What the site is
body: Sidera works out Sri Lankan birth charts (hadahan), marriage matches (porondam), auspicious times (nakath), first letters and related results from astronomical positions and the traditional rules named on each page, in Sinhala and English.

sections.title: For guidance only
body: Readings are for cultural interest and personal reflection. A porondam score shows agreement under the stated traditional rules. It does not say whether a relationship will succeed or whether two people should marry.
Sidera does not give medical, legal or financial advice, judge fertility or predict lifespan. For important decisions, speak with your family and a practising astrologer.

sections.title: Rules can differ
body: Traditions differ, and some rules here are provisional until a practising astrologer confirms them. The pages mark these. Official annual ritual times are shown apart from our own calculations.

sections.title: Accuracy
body: A result depends on the date, time, place, time zone history and method. A few minutes' difference in birth time can change the lagna, and the page warns when that is likely.

sections.title: AI explanations
body: Before anything goes to the AI, the site shows a notice, and nothing is sent until you agree. AI explanations are marked as such and can contain mistakes of fact, interpretation or translation. Please check anything important against the calculated result.

sections.title: Astro chat
body: Anyone can ask Astro 2 free questions a week on a browser, the week starting at the first question. Each full report adds a chat allowance of about 20 questions, measured by how much the answers use. It is kept until used and has no cash value.

To keep the chat fair and its cost in hand, there is also a limit per network, a daily limit per account and a limit of 1,000 characters a message, and free questions may pause on very busy days. These limits may change.

sections.title: Who can use Sidera
body: You must be 18 or older. You may use a child tool for a child who is yours or in your legal care.
Use another adult's details only with their permission for what you are doing: working out a chart, saving it, sharing it or asking the AI about it.

sections.title: Sharing
body: You choose what to share. Before sharing, check what the other person will see, and respect anyone who asks you to remove their details or delete a link.

sections.title: Your reports
body: What you enter stays yours. We use it only to give you the features you ask for, as the privacy page describes.

You may save, print and share your reports privately, with family or an adviser, when you have any permission needed. Sidera keeps its rights in its own software, design and text. Material from others, such as place names, fonts and planet positions, stays under its own licences, listed on the Credits page linked at the foot of every page. These terms do not reduce what those licences or the law allow.

sections.title: Saved reports, full reports and coupons
body: A free saved report is deleted 7 days after you save it, and you can keep up to 20 at a time. A full report needs no sign in. It is kept on this browser, or in your Google account if you sign in, until you delete it or the account.

Payment is not available yet, so for now a full report can be unlocked only with a coupon code that makes it free. Each coupon has its own limits, such as an end date, the kinds of report it covers and how many times it can be used. Terms for paid reports will be added here before payment opens.

sections.title: Fair use
body: Please do not try to open someone else's reports, get around access controls or limits, break or overload the site, pretend to be someone else, or copy the site in bulk to resell it.
We may reasonably limit access to stop misuse or protect other people. If you think a limit was a mistake, please tell us.

sections.title: Availability and responsibility
body: We take reasonable care in running the site. If something does not work, please tell us so we can look into it. We cannot promise that every reading matches every tradition, or that the site will always be available.
Nothing in these terms takes away rights the law gives you that cannot be excluded, including for fraud, or for death or personal injury caused by negligence.

sections.title: Changes, law and language
body: These terms may change. We date every change at the top of this page, give fair notice of important changes and ask for your agreement again where the law requires it.
Sri Lankan law governs these terms, along with any protection the law where you live gives you and that cannot be excluded.
The Sinhala and English versions say the same thing. If you find a difference, please tell us; neither version is used against you.

credits.title: Credits
credits.metaDescription: The data, fonts and calculations Sidera uses, where they come from and the licences they are shared under.
credits.lead: Sidera stands on other people's work. Here are the data, fonts and calculations we use, where they come from and the licences they are shared under.

places.title: Places
places.text: Place names, coordinates and time zones come from GeoNames, shared under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. The data is provided "as is", without warranty.
changes: For Sri Lanka we keep only the populated places from the GeoNames file for the country. Places in other countries are those with 1,000 or more people.
We leave out Sinhala names that are not written correctly, such as those with a vowel sign before the consonant or with letters from another script.
We use our own list of province names in place of the GeoNames ones, which have errors.
We put the places into a search index that lists larger places first.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.text: The site uses five font families. Each is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which allows them to be used on websites and shared.

names.title: Baby names
names.text: The name suggestions on the baby name pages draw on Wikipedia, shared under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence.
names.wikipedia: From Wikipedia: the names in its Sinhalese given names categories, whether each is a boy's or a girl's name, and the meanings of a few names, taken from their Wikipedia pages.
names.people: Names we added: each links a Wikipedia article about a Sri Lankan person with that name, to show the name is in real use. We take nothing else from those articles.
names.ours: Our own work: the Sinhala spellings of the names we added, and all the other meanings, written from the Sanskrit, Pali or Sinhala root words.
names.where: Every suggested name links the Wikipedia page it comes from. Pick a birth star on the baby names page to see them.

avurudu.title: Avurudu times
avurudu.text: We calculate only the dawn of the new year and the punya kalaya. Every other Avurudu time is published exactly as the official list for that year gives it.
